notes: Official USMLE Step 1 specifications rechecked 2026-08-30 support endocrine foundational-science classification.

Endotext NBK278930, updated 2024 and rechecked 2026-08-30, states that glucocorticoid receptor resistance reduces hypothalamic/pituitary negative feedback, increases CRH/ACTH and cortisol, and drives mineralocorticoid-active steroids and androgens without classic Cushingoid features.

Endotext NBK278930 — Primary Generalized Glucocorticoid Resistance Syndrome: Pathophysiology and Clinical Manifestations.

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: High cortisol plus high ACTH, absent Cushingoid features, mineralocorticoid/androgen effects and NR3C1 loss-of-function indicate generalized glucocorticoid resistance; ACTH stays elevated because central negative feedback is impaired.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: A corticotroph adenoma can raise ACTH but is superseded by the explicit NR3C1 resistance phenotype; CBG elevation and 11β-HSD2 do not explain the full pattern; increased receptor sensitivity predicts ACTH suppression.
